generalInspection.procedure: Inspect the general condition of the Welder
checkItems: Misalignment or binding of moving parts
Any other condition that may affect its safe operation
generalInspection.safetyWarning: Unplug the Welder, rest the tool on a heat-proof, electrically non-conductive surface, and allow all parts of the Welder to cool thoroughly before service

dustRemoval.procedure: Remove rear panel and blow out interior dust
steps: Have a qualified technician remove the Rear Panel
Use compressed air to blow out all dust from the interior
dustRemoval.note: This should be performed by a qualified technician

afterUseStorage.procedure: Store welder in clean and dry location
steps: Store in a clean and dry location

migGunNozzleAndTipInspection.timing: Before each use (for optimal MIG/Flux-Cored wire weld quality)
migGunNozzleAndTipInspection.procedure: Clean and inspect the MIG Gun Contact Tip and Nozzle
migGunNozzleAndTipInspection.safetyWarning: Make sure that the entire MIG Gun is completely cool and that the Power Cord is unplugged from the electrical outlet before proceeding

steps.action: Pull the Nozzle to remove it
Scrub the interior of the Nozzle clean with a wire brush
Examine the end of the Nozzle
inspectionPoints: The end should be flat and even
If the end is uneven, chipped, melted, cracked, or otherwise damaged, the Nozzle will adversely affect the weld and should be replaced

steps.action: Unscrew the Contact Tip counterclockwise and slide it off the welding wire to remove
Scrub the outside of the Tip clean with a wire brush
steps.detail: Clean out the inside of the tip with a tip cleaner (sold separately)

steps.action: Check that the Tip is the proper type for the wire size used
Examine the shape of the hole at the end of the Contact Tip
inspectionPoints: It should be an even circle
It should not be oblong or have any bulges in it

steps.action: If any problems are noted, replace the Contact Tip
steps.detail: Select a new Tip of the correct size for the welding wire used

steps.action: Reinstall the Tip and securely reinstall the Nozzle as well
Carefully pry frame off of Display
steps.detail: Insert flathead screwdriver (sold separately) into one of the side slots

steps.action: Insert a new Screen Cover into Screen Frame
steps.detail: Insert with the gap facing downward

steps.action: Insert frame back into slot on Display
steps.detail: Place the top end in first
